# Gramlot 0.3.4 — Keep numeric region sizes synchronized

Dragging a border splitter now writes its constrained numeric pixel size through the region's plain reactive width/height binding. Sliders and other Data consumers update during the drag and keyboard resize. Numeric region dimensions are converted to CSS inside the component.

Source declarations, mounted content and completed-resize notification timing remain unchanged. CSS strings and transformed pointers remain presentation-only; no inverse template conversion is introduced.

Verified with border and container regressions, the core suite, Python collection metadata, and Python/JavaScript galleries in Chromium and WebKit.
